name: baip-lens
description: Read-only scanner for SAP BTP Cloud Foundry landscapes and CAP projects: inventory, runtime health, outdated libraries and security posture.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-report-template.mjs
scripts.sample: node dist/cli.js report --from test/fixtures/sample-snapshot.json --format html,json,csv,sarif --out ../../reports/sample && node dist/cli.js report --from test/fixtures/sample-project-snapshot.json --format html,json,csv,sarif --out ../../reports/sample-project
